Composition API: provide().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { provide } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Must be called synchronously during `setup()`.

Composition API: inject().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { inject } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Must be called synchronously during `setup()`. A second argument supplies the fallback used when no ancestor provides the key.

Composition API: InjectionKey.description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue'`). TS only.
A `Symbol` carrying the provided value's type, so `provide()` / `inject()` stay type-checked.
